scholarships.title: Aga Khan Foundation International Scholarship Programme (AKF ISP) - Next Cycle, Opening Early 2027
scholarships.official_source: Aga Khan Foundation (Aga Khan Development Network)

eligibility: hold a Bachelor's degree or equivalent training/professional experience;
demonstrate a thoughtful, reliable, multi-source funding plan that covers all years of study;
be admitted to a reputable postgraduate institution;
be starting the first year of the programme; and
have strong leadership potential, professional experience, extracurricular and/or entrepreneurial achievements, and volunteer contributions.
Note: preference is given to young professionals under 30 years of age.

The programme is available in Afghanistan, Australia, Bangladesh, Egypt, India, Kenya, Kyrgyz Republic, Madagascar, Mozambique, New Zealand, Pakistan, Syria, Tajikistan, Tanzania, and Uganda. In countries such as Canada, Portugal and the USA, applications are accepted from those who are originally from one of the countries listed above. At this time, AKF ISP is not available to students who wish to study in the United Kingdom or Russia.
existing.eligibility_summary: Applicants must have excellent academic records, hold a Bachelor's degree or equivalent, demonstrate genuine financial need, show a reliable multi-source funding plan covering all years, be admitted to a reputable postgraduate institution, be starting the first year of the programme, and show strong leadership potential and achievements; preference is given to those under 30.
benefits: For PhD students, the first two years of study
Awards are structured as half grant and half loan, so 50 percent of the award amount is repayable with a service charge
coverage: For PhD students, the first two years of study
Awards are structured as half grant and half loan, so 50 percent of the award amount is repayable with a service charge
requirements: Awards are provided according to need, but the AKF ISP should be considered a resource of last resort; applicants should secure multiple sources of funding to reduce the amount requested.
Applicants must be entering their first year of study in a postgraduate programme. Students who have already enrolled in, or have commenced their postgraduate studies, are not eligible.
Applications for part-time programmes and short-term courses are not considered.
A guarantor is required to co-sign the award agreement.

Repayment of the loan component, which includes a service charge, begins six months after the first of the following events: a) graduation, b) termination of studies, or c) withdrawal of support following failure to meet the academic standards expected of ISP students.
To maintain an AKF ISP award, the award holder must demonstrate good academic standing as well as ongoing financial need during the course of the postgraduate programme.
documents: Application submitted through the local AKF contact in the applicant's country of eligibility
Evidence of admission to a reputable postgraduate institution
A multi-source funding plan covering all years of study
Academic records demonstrating excellent academic performance
Evidence of leadership potential, professional experience, extracurricular and/or entrepreneurial achievements, and volunteer contributions
Guarantor co-signature on the award agreement
application_method: Verify eligibility and find the local contact using the AKDN eligibility chatbot on the AKDN international scholarships page.
Contact the AKF team in the applicant's country, since applications are handled by contacts in countries where AKF ISP is available.
Apply through that local contact for the cycle, which opens annually; the 2026-2027 cycle is closed and the next opens in early 2027.
If selected, obtain a guarantor to co-sign the award agreement before the award is confirmed.
existing.selection_notes: Award recipients are selected through a global, annual and competitive application process. The AKF ISP offers a limited number of new awards in each cycle. The published criteria are academic record, financial need, quality of the funding plan, quality of the admitting institution, first-year status, and leadership and achievement profile, with preference given to young professionals under 30.
existing.best_fit: High-achieving scholars from AKF ISP countries, including India, who are financially unable to fund postgraduate study themselves, are entering the first year of a Master's or PhD, and can show a credible multi-source funding plan.
existing.notes: Half grant, half loan: 50 percent of the award amount must be repaid, including a service charge, and a guarantor must co-sign the agreement. Repayment begins six months after graduation, termination of studies, or withdrawal of support for failing the expected academic standards. For PhD students the award covers the first two years only, after which alternative funding must be found, so it is not renewable beyond that. To keep the award, the holder must maintain good academic standing and demonstrate ongoing financial need. Study in the United Kingdom or Russia is not covered. Applications for part-time programmes and short-term courses are not considered.
existing.duration: Master's scholarships are granted for the entire duration of the degree course; PhD scholarships are awarded for the first two years
existing.application_period: The 2026-2027 cycle is closed. The next cycle opens in early 2027; the programme is run through a global, annual and competitive application process, with applications handled by contacts in countries where AKF ISP is available.
existing.deadline_display: The 2026-2027 application cycle is now closed. The next cycle will open in early 2027.
